newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Petrobras still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Petrobras still a buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers/Patrimonio said in a report they were maintaining their buy rating on Brazil's state-owned oil firm Petrobras.
-- They said they expect the company to report fourth-quarter and full-year 1996 earnings of $32.9 million and $90 million, respectively.
-- For 1997, they forecast earnings of $101 million.

-- "We continue to believe that since there is no legal limitation preventing the privatization of Petrobras, the company could join the ranks of government companies being privatized in coming years," they said.
-- Petrobras preferred shares were trading at 224 reais, down 0.88 percent.
